summary: Enel Chile S.A. filed a Form 6-K interim financial statement for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, reporting net income of US$162 million, a 7% year-over-year decline, and EBITDA up 15.8% to US$423 million. The filing also notes the start of construction of the Azabache BESS battery storage project by its subsidiary. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, capital return, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, going-private, rights offering, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is announced. Routine financial disclosure; no special situation.
